title: Beyond Corrected Actions: Training LLM Agents on Textual Critiques
abstract: arXiv:2610.19367v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for multi-turn agentic tasks that require interactions with users and environments over extended sequences of actions. A common approach to improving LLM agents is to use more capable expert models to provide training supervision, either by behavior cloning the expert's trajectories or by using the expert to correct the actions in trajectories generated by the weaker student model. However, expert LLMs can provide richer supervision than actions alone: they can directly generate textual critique that explain why specific actions are incorrect. We study whether training on such feedback benefits LLM agents and propose Critique-Augmented Agentic Fine-Tuning (CAFT), a framework that elicits textual expert feedback on student-generated trajectories. For each incorrect action, the expert yields both a corrected action and a textual critique explaining the student's mistake--which we then use

translated_title: 超越纠正动作：基于文本批评训练大语言模型智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于多轮智能体任务，这类任务需要在较长的动作序列中与用户和环境进行交互。改进LLM智能体的一种常见方法是使用更强大的专家模型提供训练监督，方式要么是对专家的轨迹进行行为克隆，要么是利用专家来纠正较弱学生模型所生成轨迹中的动作。然而，专家LLM能够提供比单纯动作更丰富的监督信息：它们可以直接生成解释特定动作为何不正确的文本批评。我们研究了基于此类反馈进行训练是否对LLM智能体有益，并提出了批评增强的智能体微调，这是一个在学生模型生成的轨迹上获取专家文本反馈的框架。对于每个不正确的动作，专家会同时给出纠正后的动作以及解释学生错误的文本批评——随后我们利用这些……
tldr: 提出CAFT框架，让专家模型在学生LLM智能体生成的错误动作上同时提供纠正动作和解释性文本批评，并证明基于这种更丰富的文本反馈进行训练能更有效地提升智能体性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes CAFT, a framework where expert LLMs provide both corrected actions and textual critiques on student agents' trajectories, demonstrating that training on such rich textual feedback improves LLM agent performance beyond action correction alone.
